ja.listDescription: 日本の花火は、夏の夜空を彩る日本を代表する風物詩です。江戸時代に始まったとされ、現在では全国各地で花火大会が開催されています。色鮮やかな光が大きな円を描いて開く「菊」や「牡丹」、流れ落ちるように輝く「柳」など、職人が一発一発丹精込めて作り上げます。音や光だけでなく、打ち上げる順番や演出にも工夫が凝らされ、観客を魅了します。伝統と技術が融合した、日本ならではの美しい夏の文化です。

en.listDescription: Japanese fireworks are one of the country’s most beloved symbols of summer, lighting up the night sky with spectacular colors and shapes. Fireworks festivals are held throughout Japan, with a tradition believed to date back to the Edo period. Skilled fireworks makers carefully craft each shell by hand, creating beautiful patterns such as “Chrysanthemum” and “Peony,” which bloom in perfect circles, as well as “Willow,” whose sparkling trails cascade gracefully toward the ground. Beyond their brilliant colors and powerful sounds, the sequence and presentation of the fireworks are carefully designed to captivate the audience. Japanese fireworks are a unique summer tradition where craftsmanship and artistry come together.
